system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you cast a jutsu that requires an attack roll, you can trick your enemy into thinking each missing attack was really you. Make the attacks granted by your jutsu. Each time you miss an attack, you can spend 1 Superiority die and dismiss one Bunshin to remake the attack. If the original attack had advantage, the remade attack does not have advantage.
